reason: A DeepSeek Harness workspace file explorer that provides a browsable directory tree, file previews, reference insertion into the composer, and in-panel file editing.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中浏览工作区文件、预览内容，并将文件引用或目录列表插入聊天输入框，同时支持面板内编辑文件。
summaries.en: Browse workspace files in DeepSeek Harness, preview their contents, insert file references or directory listings into the composer, and edit files in the panel.

capabilities: Reads text-file previews and optionally inserts small file contents
Writes edited file contents to disk
Inserts file references or directory listings into the chat composer
